releases.description: Host shutdown and review-job status fixes, seen by the people who run the supervisor host.

clusters.title: Host shutdown and review-job status safety
clusters.description: Shutdown refusal, bounded workspace discovery, publication recovery, and failure propagation through review, DevPod and snapshot status. These share the host lifecycle and the rule that failed or absent state must not report success.

clusters.title: Duo standalone page delivery
clusters.description: Generated self-contained Duo page with bundled Monaco assets, loadable in WKWebView, plus stale-preview reconciliation. Both are needed for the iPhone editor to ship.
